subtitle: "Tracking Chinese fabless companies and semiconductor design operations"

description: "48 Chinese chip design firms tracked: fabless vendors, state-backed design houses and EDA/IP providers — earnings, nodes, listing status and Entity List records."
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("R/helpers.R")
library(leaflet)
library(DT)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)

firms <- load_design_firms("data/design.yml")

# Legend is derived from the data, not hardcoded: every category present gets
# a swatch, canonical order first, any unexpected extras appended so the
# legend can never silently drift from the markers.
design_categories_canonical <- c("Fabless", "State-Backed Design House", "EDA & IP Provider")
design_categories_present <- c(
  design_categories_canonical[design_categories_canonical %in% unique(firms$category)],
  setdiff(unique(firms$category), design_categories_canonical)
)
```

## Overview

As of `r format(Sys.Date(), "%B %Y")`, this tracker covers **`r nrow(firms)` design firms** spanning fabless companies, state-backed design houses, and EDA/IP providers.

## Design Firm Map

```{r map, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
firms$colour <- unname(sapply(firms$category, design_category_color))
popups <- vapply(1:nrow(firms), function(i) make_design_popup(firms[i, ]), character(1))
boundaries <- load_boundaries()

leaflet(firms, options = leafletOptions(minZoom = 3, maxZoom = 10)) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldGrayCanvas) %>%
  fitBounds(lng1 = 73, lat1 = 18, lng2 = 135, lat2 = 53) %>%
  add_boundary_layers(boundaries) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat, radius = 8,
    color = "#ffffff", fillColor = ~colour, fillOpacity = 0.85, stroke = TRUE, weight = 1.5,
    popup = popups,
    popupOptions = popupOptions(maxWidth = 320, minWidth = 220, maxHeight = 360, autoPan = TRUE, keepInView = TRUE, autoPanPadding = c(20, 20))
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    colors = unname(sapply(design_categories_present, design_category_color)),
    labels = design_categories_present,
    title = "Firm Category"
  )
```

## All Design Firms

```{r table, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Category and Designation are plain factors so DT renders dropdown filters.
table_data <- firms %>%
  mutate(
    Name = paste0('<a href="design-firms/', id, '.html">', name_en, '</a>'),
    Category = factor(category, levels = design_categories_present),
    Designation = factor(
      ifelse(entity_list_flagged, designation_label(entity_list_name), "No"),
      levels = c("No", "Entity List (BIS)", "Entity List · FN4", "DoD 1260H")
    ),
    "Design Score" = sapply(design_composite, design_score_bar_html),
    Location = paste0(city, ", ", province)
  ) %>%
  select(Name, Category, Founded = founded, "Product Focus" = product_focus, "Design Score", Location, Designation)

datatable(table_data, escape = FALSE, filter = list(position = "top", clear = TRUE), options = list(pageLength = 20, dom = "ftip", scrollX = TRUE), rownames = FALSE)
```
